text: LG Electronics, Inc. is a listed Korean company publishing investor-relations stock information; at 31 December 2025 its largest shareholder was the group's holding company LG Corp. with 32% of its shares, while domestic investors held 37% and foreign investors 31%.
short: LG Electronics' largest shareholder is LG Corp. (32%, end-2025); no controlling shareholder shown.
